sentences.en: Capo Boi, a small cape tucked into the eastern curve of the bay, is certainly one of the loveliest.

sentences.en: The BOI is the lead agency of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) in promoting investments in the Philippines.

sentences.en: The BOI handholds business concerns and links them to essential chains of service where it matches prospective investors with local and foreign business entities.

sentences.en: The narrow Vall de Boi is situated in the high Pyrenees, in the Alta Ribagorca region and is surrounded by steep mountains.
